messages:
nicole: quick idea 30 Can the console show an "Estimated units" hint for embeddings before the user calls the API? could save support churn around 413s and billing surprises.
rajan: +1. we already have heuristics on ingress for dims/bytes. do we want the console to show both a bytes estimate (for transport) and dims estimate (for cost)?
evelyn: runtime perspective = dims map better to runtime cost, bytes map to 413/transport limits. recommend showing both briefly: e.g. 'Est. billing units: 2.4k dims — Payload: 5.1 KB' and a split suggestion. keep it tiny in the UI.
sam: UX: show one-line hint and a 'details' dropdown that explains how we estimate and gives a suggested curl snippet for splitting. avoid heavy terms in the primary line.
nicole: telemetry: we should track when the hint is shown and when users accept the suggested split. propose events: embed_console.preflight_shown and embed_console.preflight_applied.
rajan: implementation thought: don't compute this for every console edit. add a lightweight preflight endpoint `/v1/embeddings/preflight` that accepts same body but returns estimation only (204 or 200 with headers). clients can opt-in with header `X-Embed-Preflight: 1`. preflight should be cheap and rate-limited.
evelyn: prefer separate preflight path rather than adding to main path. ensures no extra compute on hot path and easier to throttle. also mark preflight as non-billable or minimal cost.
sam: console UX flow: call preflight when user pastes a large array/file or toggles a preview switch. let users enable 'auto preflight' in settings. show 'mixed dims' if inputs have varying vector lengths and recommend client-side split in that case.
nicole: note for support docs: when mixed dims are detected show example chunking snippet and link to embed-sizing doc. snippet example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": ["...first-256-rows...","...rest..."]}'
```
rajan: telemetry: include dims,size,route_id,tenant_id in preflight_shown event. also expose a per-route dashboard metric for % of requests that used preflight and % that applied suggestion.
evelyn: important: estimator must use identical math as billing (tokenization/byte accounting + rounding) to avoid discrepancies and tickets. sync with billing. also handle mixed-dim arrays by returning a 'mixed' flag instead of a single dims number.
nicole: rollout plan: UI behind feature flag, telemetry enabled, server preflight available behind flag. rollout Canary: 10% tenants -> 50% -> 100% over a week.
rajan: i'll add server flag + header and a canary rollout job. infra-bot: deploy scheduled by rajan: canary embed-preflight endpoint enabled for 10% tenants :rocket:
evelyn: runtime note: ensure preflight's estimation logic mirrors splitter service for consistent split suggestions. also add unit tests for edgecases (empty input arrays, very large single items, mixed dims).
sam: product wants a compact console card showing preflight conversion rate and average suggested splits per model route. we'll emit metrics to support that.
nicole: action items: rajan = preflight endpoint + rollout flag, evelyn = estimator parity & tests, sam = UI mock + settings toggle, nicole = telemetry spec + dashboard layout. sync tomorrow 11am. :thumbsup:
